S05 E42 — Shopping Day at Live; Under Pressure Week
Hailee Steinfeld talks about Disney's "Hexed"; it's "Shopping Day at Live" with Shannon Doherty; "Under Pressure Week" continues with advice on de-stressing your tech, from Lance Ulanoff.
